description: The Treasury's cash at the Fed each business day since 2005 (the Treasury General Account, from the Daily Treasury Statement), its change and range over the window, and optionally the last day's largest deposits and withdrawals by category (taxes withheld, debt issued and redeemed, interest, Social Security) with month and fiscal year to date.

flows.description: Also the last day's largest deposits and withdrawals by category, with the month and fiscal year to date.

name: treasury_cash

outputSchema.description: rows are business days with the closing balance in millions of US dollars; flows holds the last day's largest deposits and withdrawals.

title: Treasury cash (Daily Treasury Statement)
